findings: Smooth hour numerals remain visible within irregularly packed circles.
All three palette families appear across hero, next-minute and quarter-hour captures.
Monochrome filled numerals and outlined background circles remain distinct, including two-digit noon.
Caption and optional outlined hands remain readable on all six native layouts.
Round captures keep the entire plate and caption within the visible display.
limits: Representative native frames. Physical wrist taps, sunlight readability and battery use remain unmeasured.
